estimator_comparison.why: The plant spans about ten decades of gain, so an FFT-based estimate from broadband excitation is leakage-limited at high frequency. Stepped sine drives one tone at a time and rejects everything else by correlation, which is also what is done on hardware for a plant with this much rolloff. The two were compared against the known plant and the choice follows that measurement.

note: The validation fit is measured on a random-phase multisine the model was never fitted to; the training fit is a chirp. Only the validation number is meaningful. Identification sees B_sensor only, as on hardware.
